scope: Three roots: shared all-tag matching, avatar styling complexity, and tabs header complexity. Generated artifacts, suppressions, dependencies and unrelated edits untouched.

rootCauses.name: Repeated all-tag scans across story/category filtering
rootCauses.impact: All-tag filters repeatedly searched each item's tag list for every required tag. Large matching lists incur repeated work. Small inputs can be slightly slower with indexing; no live-site speedup claimed.
rootCauses.fix: Share a requested-tag Set across items, retain a fast first-tag rejection, then count unique matching tags. Preserve duplicate semantics and empty requirements. Leave any-tag paths as original array scans; no Set is allocated for that mode.
rootCauses.tests: Seven matcher/story tests cover empty inputs, duplicates, case sensitivity, successful/failed membership, sorting, limits and source identity. Seven existing category tests cover any/all tags, ID fallback, duplicates, missing tag references and order.

rootCauses.name: Avatar style precedence complexity
rootCauses.impact: Maintenance improvement; no intended visual or interaction change. Size presets, custom size, explicit font size, colors and image-background precedence were mixed with rendering.
rootCauses.fix: Extract cohesive style calculation and leave Avatar rendering/content order in the component. Preserve unknown-size logging, default variant and all precedence rules.
rootCauses.tests: Five tests pass before and after: preset letter sizes, icon sizing, custom/font overrides, image transparency, custom color, class/variant and child order.

rootCauses.name: Tabs header rendering complexity
rootCauses.impact: Maintenance improvement; no intended UI behavior change. Header labels/icons and responsive TabList configuration obscured selection and carousel coordination.
rootCauses.fix: Extract a module-scope TabsHeader with explicit content/responsive/orientation/selection props. Keep active state, grid layout, panels and carousel ownership in LmTabs.
rootCauses.tests: Two tests pass before and after with plain/styled labels, desktop vertical widths, icons, tab-to-carousel and carousel-to-tab synchronization, mobile scrollable layout and preserving selection across responsive updates.

recipeReview: Fetched canonical recipes with no-cache curl and read validation/false-positive criteria. Benchmarked indexing including construction. Rejected any-tag conversion after measured regression. Retained the first-tag fast rejection after a wider benchmark exposed a regression in the first all-tag version. UI refactors separate coherent responsibilities while preserving state/render order and interfaces.
grouping: Both all-tag loops use the same matching algorithm and one shared correction, counted as one root. Avatar and tabs are independent complexity roots.

benchmark.method: Actual old/new legacyFilterAllStories source transpiled and executed with equal-output assertions. Five warmups and 25 timed calls, median. Includes requested Set construction, per-item matching and sorting. Synthetic workloads, not live CMS data. Requested Set uses O(unique required tags) memory; transient matched Set is bounded by the same count. Exploratory heap measurements were noisy and not treated as reliable byte counts.
benchmark.tradeoff: Small inputs are slower by roughly 0.001–0.031 ms per measured batch. Large all-match workload improves by about 2.74 ms; first-tag rejection remains close to the original. Other tag distributions can have different tradeoffs.

validation.tests: 21 tests pass across 4 files; avatar and tabs preservation tests also passed before changes
validation.eslint: Eight changed source/test files pass without warnings/errors
validation.overallCount: 72 to 67. Four source removals belong to this pass; one generated diagnostic also disappeared outside this work and is not claimed as a fix.
validation.limitations: No production build, browser visual comparison or live CMS benchmark. UI tests mock rendering boundaries and responsiveness.

followUp: Any-tag membership loops intentionally unchanged after benchmark evidence.
Other component complexity, tiny grid lookups, initialization and remaining source warnings.
